annotations.title: Check the rules for a bus

description: The US federal rules and published guidance that apply to a church, school, camp, senior living community, medical transport (NEMT) operator or hotel buying a bus: CDL, the school bus rule for new vehicles, insurer guidance on 15-passenger vans, ADA accessibility for new vehicles, the hotel shuttle exception and USDOT number, insurance minimums, and Section 5310 funding. Each with its citation. Federal only.

new_vehicle.description: true if buying new. Several rules cover new vehicles only.

passengers.description: Passenger seats, not counting the driver.

name: check_vehicle_rules
